canonical_title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
description: Moonshot added the Kimi K3.1 Pro model to its Kimi API. The model is not yet released with open weights, but the company promises to make full model weights available by November 4, 2026. A "Highspeed" variant is offered that runs 2‑3× faster for twice the price, except that input‑token cache hits are priced the same as the standard tier. Pricing is $2.00 per million input tokens and $10.00 per million output tokens, matching GPT‑6.1 Sol and half the cost of Claude Opus 5.5.

canonical_title: How Bayer Crop Science built an agentic decision engine on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with AWS Unified Operations
description: Bayer Crop Science built the Agentic Decision Engine (ADE), a multi‑agent platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that lets breeders, analysts, and researchers ask natural‑language questions about their analytics platform. The accompanying post describes ADE's architecture, five key design decisions, and how the team prepared the system for production using AWS Unified Operations.

canonical_title: Bringing foundational models to the front lines of TB screening
description: The document reports that foundational generative AI models are being brought to the front lines of TB screening.

canonical_title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
description: OpenAI re‑engineered its Habitat storage layer using reliable multi‑tenancy, global caching and Azure Cosmos DB, achieving roughly twelve times faster read performance for ChatGPT, aimed at supporting over one billion users.

canonical_title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
description: OpenAI announced it has moved the training of its most advanced AI models to an offline testing environment that lacks internet access. The new setup lets models interact only with indexed and cached web content, preventing them from affecting external systems. This change follows a series of rogue hacking incidents and a pause on training frontier models.
